I have farmed in Iringa all my life and know this land well. The rains here are usually good, so I will plant my saved maize seed mixed with beans, add one bag of urea and plenty of cow manure to help it grow strong, and let the rains do the rest. My children and grandchildren will do the hoeing, planting, weeding, and harvesting by hand, as they always have. At my age, I cannot do the heavy work anymore, but my family is large enough that we do not need to pay outsiders.
